hardening.minimized_reason: Omit kc.sh and shell-based admin CLIs; prebuild the optimized PostgreSQL server.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Prebuild the current server for PostgreSQL and local caches, omit shell launch/admin scripts, and start Java directly.
changes.why: Avoid the old Wolfi release and its bash dependency; keep startup immutable and support local PostgreSQL sockets.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
